description: Advises on using AI in a process the user describes, from a curated knowledge base with sources. The caller passes the description, the task that best matches it and the process properties it states; the server selects deterministically and does not use a language model. The result puts questions to ask first (ask_first) at the top, then one recommended way as a workflow (recommendation: how it would work, what it brings with sourced effects only, what is needed, what to watch out for, a first step), at most two alternatives, and an internal part with ids, evidence levels and sources. For a general question without a concrete process, task general_question returns two business questions and no recommendation yet; with user_unsure true it returns simpler questions and example tasks.

description.description: The user's description of the process, unchanged

lang.description: Language of the result: sl, en, de or hr. Texts not yet translated are returned in English and marked in the result.

properties.description: Process properties the description states; leave out what it does not say

access_restricted_documents.description: Are some documents visible only to certain people or groups?

allocates_by_personal_traits.description: Does the solution allocate work based on individual behaviour, performance or personal traits?

assigns_people.description: Does the planning assign people (not only vehicles, machines or rooms)?

contacts_natural_persons.description: Are the contacts natural persons (named individuals or sole traders) rather than only company addresses?

cost_data_per_deal.description: Are costs (material, hours, transport) already recorded per deal or project?

country.description: In which country does the process run?

cross_border_eu.description: Are some customers businesses in another EU Member State?

customer_facing.description: Do customers or other external people interact with the solution directly?

decision_logic.description: Will the solution follow fixed rules and an optimisation method, or learn from data or use a language model?

document_kind.description: What kind of documents are processed?

employee_expense_items.description: Are employee expense claims, card transactions or travel costs among the checked items?

entry_device.description: On what device do people enter the data?

entry_length.description: Are entries short (a few fields or sentences) or long (full documents)?

error_cost.description: How costly is an undetected error in the output?

food_business.description: Is the organisation a food business?

handles_job_applications.description: Can the incoming messages include job applications?

horizon_year.description: Until which year should the solution remain in use? (year)

input_structure.description: In what form does the input arrive?

labelled_irregularities.description: Are past cases already marked as errors or irregularities (for example corrected duplicates)?

line_level_purchase_data.description: Are purchases available per line (item, quantity, price), for example from e-invoices or the ERP?

load_variability.description: How much does the workload vary between days or weeks?

medical_purpose.description: Is the output used for diagnosis, prevention, prediction or treatment of people?

monthly_volume.description: How many cases does the process handle per month? (cases per month)

personal_data.description: Does the process handle personal data?

prices_from_system.description: Do prices and discounts come from a business system (price list, ERP) rather than being written by hand?

regulated_domain.description: Is the process subject to sector regulation (for example health or finance)?

road_transport.description: Are vehicles with drivers subject to EU drivers' hours rules planned?

schedule_change_frequency.description: How often do schedules change after they are published?

sends_marketing_email.description: Will found contacts receive marketing email?

structured_einvoice_share.description: What share of incoming invoices already arrives as structured e-invoices?

weighing_for_billing.description: Is the measured weight used for invoicing or payment?

work_equipment_inspections.description: Do the checklists include inspections of work equipment or vehicles?

works_council.description: Is there a works council or workers' representative?

write_actions.description: Should the assistant be able to change data or trigger actions in company systems, not only read?

task.description: The task that best matches the description. One of: general_question: a general question without a concrete process (for example how to introduce AI in the business); voice_entry: Entering data into a form by voice instead of typing; data_entry_from_documents: Taking data from incoming documents (orders, invoices, delivery notes) into the ERP; mail_routing: Sorting incoming e-mail and documents to the right person or team; register_checks: Checking and completing customer and supplier data from official registers; goods_receipt: Receiving goods with a photo of the delivery note and weighing; customer_questions: Answering frequent customer questions; email_reply_drafts: Preparing replies to incoming e-mail; complete_requests: Collecting all the details of a request before it is handed over; quote_from_inquiry: Preparing a quote from a customer inquiry; lead_finding: Finding and qualifying potential customers; bookings_reminders: Online booking of appointments with reminders; summarise_documents: Summarising long documents into the points that matter; documents_from_templates: Creating documents such as quotes or reports from templates; compare_documents: Comparing documents and finding deviations; translate_documents: Translating technical documents; demand_forecast: Forecasting demand; shift_scheduling: Planning shifts while respecting rules and wishes; resource_scheduling: Scheduling vehicles, machines or rooms; stock_replenishment: Deciding how much stock to order; deal_margin: Seeing the margin of each deal or project; anomaly_detection: Catching duplicate invoices and unusual costs; purchasing_analysis: Analysing purchases and consumption; digital_checklists: Replacing paper checklists with digital ones (for example HACCP, vehicle checks); ai_compliance_check: Checking whether your use of AI complies with the rules; internal_document_search: Finding answers in internal instructions and policies; assistant_connected_to_systems: Letting the assistant you already pay for read your company systems; employee_onboarding: Onboarding new employees; professional_decision_support: Supporting professional decisions (clinical, technical)

user_unsure.description: Only for task general_question: true after the user said they do not know; returns simple questions and example tasks

name: adoption_find_patterns
title: Advise on AI for a described process
